aboutPage.title: A developer who narrows problems to the end
aboutPage.intro: I work across AI, backend, frontend, and infrastructure to build flows that actually work.
aboutPage.story: Before writing code, I look at the user problem and where the system fails. In debugging, I value reproducible evidence. In implementation, I value clear state and boundaries. In deployment, I value an order that operators can follow.

mascot.noteTitle: I record curiosity and follow problems to the end
mascot.noteBody: doto — a seal exploring the emerald coast while journaling everything — is a mascot that mirrors how I work. I explore new problems freely, carefully sort and record what I run into and learn, keep technical decisions calm, and leave my notes organized so they can always be pulled back out and reused.
